ratings_why.fun: The growth has a good shape: a 3/3 Journeyman on turn 1, positional heating mid-game, then a real fork between Quench, never-cool and injury builds, with a high-roll ceiling worth chasing.
ratings_why.distinct: A counter that pays 3+2+1 and burns its owner is fresh, and handing your burns to the enemy across is new; the Reforge payout itself is still plain end-of-turn stats.

verdict_why: v2 fixed the readability problems; what is left is tuning for the owner and sims, not a fix.

points.text: The risks say to cut Masterpiece Hall Curator's cap of 'up to 3 more', but the card has no cap (next to allows up to 4 neighbours). Make the card and the risk note agree so a sim tests the same card.
Say what Ember-Slinger does in a Forge mirror: does the Heat it gives add to the enemy's own Heat for the burn, and does it ever Reforge?
Burn-Salve Matron gives little until Health is large. A small When played or End of Turn hook (Heat a damaged unit, say) would let her pull her weight on the turn you buy her.
Tiers 2 to 3 hold three generic pieces (Slag Picker, Hallmark Stamper, Quench-Bucket Lad's flat cash-out). One of them leaning on position or burns would carry the tribe's puzzle into the early shop.

standouts.why: Warden Quench cashes out the Hottest unit and reseeds its neighbours, so the hot spot moves every turn: a fresh puzzle each recruit.
Ember-Slinger turns the tribe's own cost into the weapon and makes the never-cool build a plan instead of a trap.
Thiers Grinder is a simple positional multiplier that makes 'what sits beside the piece' matter from Tier 4.

weakest.why: Burn-Salve Matron is about 0.8 bodies at mid-game, low for Tier 4, and only glue for one build.
Hallmark Stamper is a generic end-of-turn buff to Hot units with no decision attached.
Slag Picker is a stock sell-for-item economy card; the Ingot is good, the trigger is not Forge-specific.

flags.note: With Keeper of the Undying Furnace, Heat only climbs, and Crater Forge Master, Thiers Grinder and the Curator multiply it: gain per turn grows with Heat times Reforges, quadratic and more on goldens. Sim turns 10 to 14.
Ottilie's Regrow adds Attack as well as Health, and burns guarantee Health lost each fight, so stats compound by a share every fight. Not a lock, but worth the two-pass runaway check.
On a high-Heat board Ember-Slinger halves every enemy across before the first attack; the only counterplay is empty slots across.
